00058 void LFNoise0UGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00059 {
00060     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00061     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00062     float currentFreq = *(inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00063     
00064     unsigned long s1, s2, s3;
00065     random.get(s1, s2, s3);
00066     
00067     do {
00068         if (counter <= 0) {
00069             counter = int(UGen::getSampleRate() / max(currentFreq, 0.001f));
00070             counter = max(1, counter);
00071             currentValue = Ran088::nextBiFloat(s1,s2,s3);
00072         }
00073         int samplesThisTime = min(numSamplesToProcess, counter);
00074         numSamplesToProcess -= samplesThisTime;
00075         counter -= samplesThisTime;
00076         
00077         while(samplesThisTime--)
00078         {
00079             *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00080         }
00081         
00082     } while (numSamplesToProcess);
00083     
00084     random.set(s1, s2, s3);
00085 }

00102 void LFNoise1UGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00103 {
00104     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00105     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00106     float currentFreq = *(inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00107     
00108     unsigned long s1, s2, s3;
00109     random.get(s1, s2, s3);
00110     
00111     do {
00112         if (counter <= 0) {
00113             counter = int(UGen::getSampleRate() / max(currentFreq, 0.001f));
00114             counter = max(1, counter);
00115             float nextValue = Ran088::nextBiFloat(s1,s2,s3);
00116             slope = (nextValue - currentValue) / counter;
00117         }
00118         int samplesThisTime = min(numSamplesToProcess, counter);
00119         numSamplesToProcess -= samplesThisTime;
00120         counter -= samplesThisTime;
00121         
00122         while(samplesThisTime--)
00123         {
00124             *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00125             currentValue += slope;
00126         }
00127         
00128     } while (numSamplesToProcess);
00129     
00130     random.set(s1, s2, s3);

00133 LFNoise2UGenInternal::LFNoise2UGenInternal(UGen const& freq) throw()
00134 :   UGenInternal(NumInputs),
00135     random((unsigned int)this * 123463463UL + 423815L),
00136     currentValue(0.f),
00137     nextValue(random.nextBiFloat()),
00138     nextMidPoint(nextValue * 0.5f),
00139     curve(0.f),
00140     slope(0.f),
00141     counter(0)
00142 {
00143     inputs[Freq] = freq;
00144 }
00145 
00146 UGenInternal* LFNoise2UGenInternal::getChannel(const int channel) throw()

00148     return new LFNoise2UGenInternal(inputs[Freq].getChannel(channel));

00151 void LFNoise2UGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00152 {
00153     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00154     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00155     float currentFreq = *(inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00156     
00157     unsigned long s1, s2, s3;
00158     random.get(s1, s2, s3);
00159     
00160     do {
00161         if (counter <= 0) {
00162             float value = nextValue;
00163             nextValue = Ran088::nextBiFloat(s1,s2,s3);
00164             currentValue = nextMidPoint;
00165             nextMidPoint = (nextValue + value) * 0.5f;
00166             
00167             counter = int(UGen::getSampleRate() / max(currentFreq, 0.001f));
00168             counter = max(2, counter);
00169             float fseglen = (float)counter;
00170             curve = 2.f * (nextMidPoint - currentValue - fseglen * slope) / (fseglen * fseglen + fseglen);
00171         }
00172         int samplesThisTime = min(numSamplesToProcess, counter);
00173         numSamplesToProcess -= samplesThisTime;
00174         counter -= samplesThisTime;
00175         
00176         while(samplesThisTime--)
00177         {
00178             *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00179             slope += curve;
00180             currentValue += slope;
00181         }
00182         
00183     } while (numSamplesToProcess);
00184     
00185     random.set(s1, s2, s3);
00186 }
